scope: section-search cost erratum and explicit uniform-trial model
statement: Corrects needs/requires wording: chi+theta/2<3 is a sufficient conservative per-seed upper-bound budget, not a necessary lower bound or route exclusion. Uniform-sampler rejection is limited to explicitly generated/tested uniform chart trials with ordinary per-trial cost; the divisor count gives the separate trial-count lower bound. Compact bulk-family search and tighter complete cost bounds remain open under unchanged criteria. No coefficient-search data was relabelled.
